entities.summary: The Argentine University of Enterprise is a private university in Buenos Aires, Argentina. It was founded by the Argentine Chamber of Corporations. Since 2003, the university's primary faculties have included the Faculty of Economic Sciences, the Faculty of Engineering and Exact Sciences, and the Faculty of Law, Social Sciences, and Communication. It is one of the top private universities in Buenos Aires.
